# Evil Buttons

> A shadcn/ui registry of animated React components built with Motion — buttons, icons, logos, and scroll bars with live docs and CLI install.

## Documentation

- [Component docs](https://evilbuttons.radiumcoders.com/docs): Live previews, install commands, and usage for every registry item
- [Registry index](https://evilbuttons.radiumcoders.com/r/index.json): Machine-readable shadcn registry manifest

## Install

```bash
npx shadcn@latest add @evilbuttons/<component-name>
```

Example components: `click-powerup`, `shiny-button`, `sticky`, `movie-pass`, `minimal`, `scroll-bars`, `sun-dim`, `moon`, `spark-burst`, `cloud-blocks`, and logo variants (`vercel`, `shadcn`, `tanstack`).

## Source

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/radiumcoders/evil-buttons)
- [Built by Radium Coders](https://radiumcoders.com)

## Tech

Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Motion, Fumadocs, shadcn/ui registry format.
